senses.gloss:
Kūdī, written also Kūṭī in the manuscripts, occurs in the Atharvaveda and the kauśika sūtra denoting a twig--identified by the scholiast with Badarī, the jujube--which was tied to the bodies of the dead to efface their traces, presumably in order to render the return of the spirit to the old home difficult.
Foot notes v. 19, 12.
Bloomfield's edition, xliv. Cf. Bloomfield, American Journal of Philology, 11, 355; 12, 416; Roth, Festgrnss an Bo7htlingk, 98; Whitney, Translation of the Atharvaveda, 254; Macdonell, Vedic Mythology, p. 165.
